title: Safari Blue: A Dhow Day on Menai Bay
excerpt: Safari Blue is a full-day dhow trip in Menai Bay with snorkelling, sandbanks, a seafood lunch and a mangrove lagoon.
body:
"Safari Blue" is the name of a popular full-day boat trip in Menai Bay, in the southwest of Zanzibar. Several operators offer similar trips.

## A typical day

- Departure from Fumba on a traditional dhow.
- Possible dolphin sightings along the way.
- Snorkelling on a reef.
- A visit to a sandbank.
- A seafood lunch on an island, with fresh fruit.
- Swimming in a mangrove lagoon.
- Sailing back in the late afternoon.

## Menai Bay

Menai Bay is a conservation area, important for dolphins, turtles and fish.

## Who it suits

Families, couples and groups who want a relaxed day at sea.

## Tips

- Bring sunscreen, a hat and a cover-up.
- Ask about vegetarian options for lunch.
- Choose an operator with good safety equipment.

[Add a dhow day to your trip](/travel-proposal/).
